system.description: Practical data and interactive instructional protocols for research or training.
system.specialRules: Linked to Decks able to run simulspace or with sufficient performance; Powered.
system.upgrades:
• Mindbites (Q): subject-specific Investigation/History/Cultures +1.
  • News Aggregator (Q): Investigation +1.
  • Training Protocol (variable Q): structured simulspace instruction.

system.description: Virtual interrogation/viral protocol capable of attacking Ego and extracting information.
system.specialRules: Target may oppose with Discipline; requires Virtual; resolution quality grants Bonus Dice.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Interrogation (+): inflict Ego loss using protocol die, default d4.
  • Personality Frag (+++++): target effectively neutralized and information extracted.
  • Sympathy (-): interrogator loses 1 EP.
  • Terminate Protocols (---): interrogation ends.
  • Viral Strike (+): Ego loss based on virus class.
system.upgrades:
• Interrogation Protocols: each Q steps the Ego-loss die upward.
  • Sharya Protocols (QQ): Rare; inflicted EP cannot be restored; Personality Frag threshold reduced.

system.description: Virtual treatment software used to repair Ego damage and trauma loops.
system.specialRules: Requires Virtual; resolution quality grants Bonus Dice.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Ego Reconstruction (+++++): restore 2d4 EP; may grant a Specialisation in severe cases.
  • Negative Feedback (-): d6 EP becomes permanently unrecoverable.
  • Psychosurgery (+): restore EP using protocol die, default d4.
  • Trauma Loop (---): inflicts heavy additional EP loss.
system.upgrades: • Psychosurgery Protocols: each Q steps the restoration die upward.
